name: 考える
meaning: to think (about); to ponder; to consider
description: Deep contemplation sharpens the minds of all allies, boosting their attack power.

name: 知る
description: Shares knowledge of enemy weak points with all allies, boosting their attack power.

name: 教える
description: Instructs all allied creatures in battle techniques, raising their attack power.

name: 覚える
meaning: to memorize; to remember; to learn by heart
description: Recalls stored knowledge to mend all allied creatures, restoring a portion of their health.

name: 忘れる
description: A wave of forgetfulness washes over the opposing party, confusing them into acting erratically.
